title: The Static of Station Meridian
author: Mirabel Ashgrove
blurb: Ivo Vane, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
